summary:
# 每日彙整報告

## 📰 今日重點摘要
1. 美國財政部切斷MEXC與美國金融系統的聯繫，因其涉嫌進行160億美元的非法交易。
2. Gnosis Pay發生數據洩露事件，個人資料及加密錢包信息遭曝光，但資金未受影響。
3. 比特幣價格跌破75,000美元，加密市場整體表現不佳，未能隨科技股反彈。
4. 希臘通過加密稅法，對獲利徵收10%稅，質押和DeFi則徵收15%稅。
5. 恐懼貪婪指數降至25，顯示市場氛圍極度恐懼。

## 📊 市場概況
今天的加密貨幣市場整體氛圍偏向悲觀，主流幣種普遍下滑。比特幣（BTC）目前價格為$75,925，較前日下跌0.14%。以太坊（ETH）小幅上漲0.34%，價格為$2,243.39，但仍未脫離下行趨勢。其他幣種如Solana（SOL）和XRP也面臨下跌壓力，特別是XRP下滑達2.81%。整體市場未能隨科技股的回升而回暖，顯示出資金流出的趨勢。

## 🔍 技術分析解讀
從技術指標來看，比特幣的相對強弱指數（RSI）為39.24，顯示出市場處於空頭壓力中。以太坊的RSI為41.02，同樣顯示出弱勢。Solana和BNB的RSI分別為30.64和41.58，均顯示出下行壓力。所有主要幣種的均線信號均為空頭，反映出短期內市場多頭乏力，仍需觀察後續走勢。

## 😱 市場情緒
當前恐懼貪婪指數為25，顯示市場處於極度恐懼狀態。這通常代表投資者情緒低迷，對未來市場走勢持悲觀態度。社群情緒普遍受到近期負面新聞影響，如MEXC事件及Gnosis Pay洩露，許多投資者選擇觀望，導致成交量下降。

## ⚠️ 風險提醒
近期市場動盪不安，特別是與監管有關的新聞可能進一步影響市場情緒。切斷MEXC與美國金融系統的聯繫以及Gnosis Pay數據洩露事件，都顯示出加密市場在合規性方面面臨挑戰。投資者需謹慎評估風險，避免盲目跟風。

## 🎯 今日觀察重點
投資者應密切關注美國財政部的後續行動及相關監管政策的變化，特別是對MEXC的影響。此外，隨著比特幣及其他主流幣種的價格走勢，需觀察市場情緒是否能有改善跡象。特別是科技股的表現是否能帶動加密市場回暖，將成為重要指標。

news.title: Former FBI Agent Pleads Guilty to Stealing $2.5M in Crypto From 35 Investigations
news.summary: Patrick Yaroch drained wallets using credentials the FBI had collected, then asked ChatGPT for advice on starting a new life in Europe.
news.title_zh: 前FBI特工承認在35起調查中竊取250萬美元加密貨幣
news.summary_zh: 一名前FBI特工因竊取250萬美元的加密貨幣而認罪，涉案調查數達35起。

news.title: GOPAX halts crypto trading, withdrawals to move all assets to cold storage
news.summary: South Korea’s GOPAX suspended trading, deposits and standard withdrawals after a hacking threat, with manual withdrawals available through support.
news.title_zh: GOPAX暫停加密貨幣交易和提款，將所有資產轉移至冷錢包
news.summary_zh: GOPAX宣布暫停所有加密交易和提款，以確保資產安全，轉移至冷錢包。

news.title: Binance’s $6.3B hack leaves questions over hot wallet safeguards
news.summary: Experts say blockchain records show repeated wallet drains but cannot establish Binance’s internal signing controls or transaction limits.
news.title_zh: Binance的63億美元黑客事件引發對熱錢包安全性的質疑
news.summary_zh: Binance遭遇重大黑客事件後，市場對熱錢包的安全性提出了質疑。

news.title: Zcash's NU7 Upgrade Goes Live, Recycling 60% of Fees to Fund Future Block Rewards
news.summary: The Network Sustainability Mechanism will reissue removed ZEC from 2031 within the 21 million cap, as the community debates its dev fund.
news.title_zh: Zcash的NU7升級正式上線，回收60%手續費以資助未來區塊獎勵
news.summary_zh: Zcash推出NU7升級，將60%的手續費回收用於支持未來的區塊獎勵。

news.title: Bitcoin recovers $76,000 level as ETFs shed $430 million after tech rout
news.title_zh: 比特幣回升至76,000美元，ETF在科技股崩盤後損失4.3億美元
news.summary_zh: 比特幣價格回升至76,000美元，但ETF在科技股崩盤後遭遇大幅資金流出。

news.title: Zcash NU7 upgrade goes live, leaves 12,224 ZEC stranded in Sprout pool
news.summary: Zcash’s NU7 upgrade has rendered about $15 million in legacy Sprout funds unspendable, although a future network upgrade could potentially restore access.
news.title_zh: Zcash NU7升級上線，12,224 ZEC被困Sprout池中
news.summary_zh: Zcash的NU7升級正式上線，但導致12,224 ZEC資金被困在Sprout池中。

news.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains and 15% levy on DeFi income
news.title_zh: 希臘批准對加密貨幣收益徵收10%稅，DeFi收入徵收15%稅
news.summary_zh: 希臘政府決定對加密貨幣收益徵收10%稅，並對DeFi收入徵收15%稅。

news.title: Hyperliquid Strategies seeks futures registration for perps
news.summary: The HYPE treasury company spent $785 million on tokens during the quarter and wants to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the US.
news.title_zh: Hyperliquid Strategies尋求期貨合約的註冊
news.summary_zh: Hyperliquid Strategies正在尋求對其期貨合約的正式註冊。

news.title: Kalshi hit with injunction over sports contracts on California tribal lands
news.summary: A federal judge has granted the preliminary injunction to bar Kalshi from offering sports contracts on the lands of two California tribes.
news.title_zh: Kalshi因加州部落土地上的體育合約遭受禁令
news.summary_zh: Kalshi因在加州部落土地上提供的體育合約而受到法律禁令。

news.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs post $530M outflows as election gains evaporate
news.summary: US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs shed a combined $530 million Thursday as Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and US stocks tumbled.
news.title_zh: 比特幣和以太坊ETF流出5.3億美元，選舉收益化為泡影
news.summary_zh: 比特幣和以太坊ETF在選舉後出現5.3億美元的資金流出。

news.title: Trump-backed World Liberty Financial plans token buyback after 66% year-to-date slide
news.title_zh: 特朗普支持的World Liberty Financial計劃在年初下滑66%後回購代幣
news.summary_zh: World Liberty Financial計劃在股價大幅下滑後進行代幣回購。

news.title: Zcash’s major network upgrade NU7 goes live on mainnet, cutting block time by threefold
news.summary: NU7 also activates the Network Sustainability Mechanism, which removes 60% of each block's transaction fees from circulation.
news.title_zh: Zcash主要網絡升級NU7上線，區塊時間縮短三倍
news.summary_zh: Zcash的NU7升級正式上線，顯著縮短了區塊生成時間。

news.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed password hashes and live tokens
news.summary: Chainalysis disclosed password hashes and live tokens were exposed after initially reporting only non-sensitive customer data was accessed.
news.title_zh: Chainalysis表示數據洩露暴露了密碼雜湊和實時代幣
news.summary_zh: Chainalysis報告指出，最近的數據洩露事件暴露了密碼雜湊和實時代幣。

news.title: Zcash’s landmark NU7 upgrade goes live, speeding up private payments
news.title_zh: Zcash的里程碑NU7升級上線，加速私密支付
news.summary_zh: Zcash的NU7升級正式上線，提升了私密支付的速度。

news.title: Crypto exchanges tout cold storage ratios after Binance attack
news.summary: Coinbase says it keeps more than 99% of customer assets offline, while Gate reports 88.26% of its total assets are kept in cold storage.
news.title_zh: 加密貨幣交易所強調冷錢包儲存比例以應對幣安攻擊
news.summary_zh: 在幣安遭受攻擊後，各大加密貨幣交易所開始強調其冷錢包的儲存比例，以增強用戶信心。

news.title: IREN’s bitcoin mining revenue drops 58% as firm plans full exit by year-end
news.summary: IREN has been shifting its focus to the AI infrastructure business, and its AI cloud revenue rose 182% in the past quarter to $200 million.
news.title_zh: IREN的比特幣挖礦收入下降58%，計劃年底前全面退出
news.summary_zh: IREN公司因市場不景氣，其比特幣挖礦收入大幅下降，並計劃在年底前完全退出該業務。

news.title: Ark Invest buys more Coinbase as shares plunge 10% in wider market rout
news.summary: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest bought $2.44 million worth of Coinbase on Thursday as the stock plunged 9.69% amid a broader sell-off.
news.title_zh: Ark Invest在市場大跌中增持Coinbase，股價下跌10%
news.summary_zh: 儘管市場普遍下跌，Ark Invest仍選擇增持Coinbase的股份，顯示對其長期潛力的信心。

news.title: Hyperliquid treasury firm seeking U.S. regulatory nod as a domestic futures platform
news.title_zh: Hyperliquid財務公司尋求美國監管批准成為國內期貨平台
news.summary_zh: Hyperliquid計劃成為美國的期貨交易平台，並正在尋求相關的監管批准以合法運營。
